description: The Water Distribution System Research Database index page names ten further systems for which the entry page carries no EPANET file link, or no entry page exists: Toms River, New Jersey (Morris Maslia, ATSDR), the Two-Loop system (Alperovits and Shamir, via Avi Ostfeld), the KYPIPE system (the Don Wood system in the spreadsheet), the Battle of the Water Sensor Networks (Ostfeld), Micropolis and Mesopolis (Kelly Brumbelow, Texas A&M), the WSS_set_2280 sets (Mair and Sitzenfrei, Innsbruck), the Exnet system (Dragan Savic, Exeter), WDS-Designer (Mair and Sitzenfrei) and E-Town (WDSA 2016 Battle of the Networks). Several entry pages link only a PDF whose file name suggests it is shared with other entries, and the summary spreadsheet holds no counts for them. The record exists so the systems can be found and requested through the database page or the UKnowledge collection, and so that the contributors' own sites can be checked. Coverage is mixed: Toms River is a real US system and the others are synthetic or research benchmarks; no dates are stated beyond 2016. No licence is stated; the pages carry only a copyright notice. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. Uses include optimisation, sensor placement, synthetic network generation and calibration studies. Related records: DynaVIBe-Web and the Innsbruck generators, the Battle of the Water Futures dataset, EPANET and the database record.
